standard-dialogue-before-the-feud.npc: Ahh, a kind stranger. Get this old man another drink so that he may wet his throat and talk to you.

standard-dialogue-after-the-feud.npc: What were we talking about again? Yes yes, when I was a boy... no, that's not it.

steps.npc: Wha'? Are you lookin' at me? Are you lookin' at me? You know something? You're drunk, you are.
Did you hear the one where the camel walks into the bar and orders a pint? The barman asks 'Why the long face!'.
Did you hear the one about the man who walked into a bar? He hurt his foot! Hah!
I've got a lovely bunch of coconuts! Hehehe...
You know, I have this friend, and she... I can't remember. What was I saying?
Thank you my friend - now if you don't mind I'm having a conversation with my imaginary friend Ali here.
I was a sailor once, you know...

when-using-any-other-item-on-drunken-ali.npc: Eh? What's this? I don't want that, get me a beer.
